summary: Crescent Energy's subsidiary signed a definitive purchase and sale agreement to acquire certain Eagle Ford assets from Devon Energy Production Company, L.P. for $4.22 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments including reductions for post-July 1, 2026 hydrocarbon proceeds. The economic effective date is July 1, 2026, with closing expected in Q4 2026 or early 2027, pending closing conditions and regulatory approvals. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. issued a debt commitment letter for a bridge credit facility up to $2.0 billion. The 8-K also provides pro forma financials reflecting this deal plus the completed Vital Energy Merger and Ridgemar Acquisition. Watch financing, regulatory clearance, and oil-price risk.
